verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team-chat platform, so a developer UI-component axis (modals, buttons, structured message layouts) applies. The evidence shows agents replying via the CLI, canvases, workflow approvals and NIP-29 group chat, but no documented developer framework for interactive message components, modals or buttons. Canvases and workflow approvals are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts
